name: wireframing
description: Scaffold a Vue 3 + Vite + TypeScript wireframe application using the @for-the-people-initiative/wireframe-kit design system v1.0.1+ (hand-drawn Rough.js components — Button, Card, Hero, Form, DataTable, plus PhoneFrame / TabletFrame / DesktopFrame / DeviceFrame). Produces a runnable click-through app with vue-router, one .vue file per screen wrapped in the platform-appropriate device frame, auto-discovered routes via import.meta.glob, router.push wiring on CTAs / tabs / back / row actions, Demo controls on Home for unreachable entry points, and a screen-picker fallback nav. Plain generic placeholder copy by default (bracketed intent copy opt-in). Embeds component catalogue + import patterns + setup conventions. Distinct from concept-sketching (lower-fi storyboards) and user-flow-diagramming (steps not screens).
